companyContext: Lidl is an international discount supermarket chain operating over 12,000 stores across Europe and the United States. Part of the Schwarz Group, Lidl emphasises providing quality products at market-leading prices, with a strong private-label strategy making up over 80% of its product range. Lidl's vision is to enhance the lives of customers through quality, value, and customer satisfaction, while pursuing sustainability under its 'A Better Tomorrow' CSR initiative.
brandContext: PARKSIDE is Lidl's private-label brand for tools, garden equipment, and accessories, named the best-selling DIY brand in Europe by Euromonitor International in 2024. The brand targets DIY beginners, enthusiasts, and professionals with a philosophy of empowerment captured in its tagline 'You got this!'. PARKSIDE covers workshop power tools (drills, saws, grinders), garden tools (lawn mowers, hedge trimmers, grass trimmers, high-pressure cleaners), cordless battery systems (X 12V Team and X 20V Team), and a higher-end sub-line called PARKSIDE PERFORMANCE. For spring and summer DIYers, the range focuses on garden machinery (robotic and corded lawn mowers, hedge trimmers, grass trimmers, garden shears, irrigation tools), outdoor project tools (high-pressure cleaners, paint spray guns), and the full cordless ecosystem for home improvement and outdoor renovation projects.

brandVision: PARKSIDE aims to empower everyone — from first-time DIYers to seasoned home improvers — to tackle any project with confidence. The brand's direction is focused on continuously expanding its product ecosystem across workshop, home, and garden categories, integrating smart technologies (Bluetooth batteries, app-connected devices, robotic mowers), and delivering the best possible quality at an unbeatable price-performance ratio. For spring and summer, the brand positions itself as the go-to companion for seasonal garden projects, outdoor renovations, and home improvement tasks, inspired by its partnership with Arnold Schwarzenegger and the motivational message: 'You got this!'
brandValues: PARKSIDE stands for empowerment ('You got this!'), accessibility (quality tools available to everyone at the best price), reliability (strict safety and quality controls on all products), sustainability (eco-friendly packaging, responsibly sourced materials, giving things a second life through DIY), innovation (smart battery systems, app-connected devices, continuously expanding range), and value for money (best-selling DIY brand in Europe, unbeatable price-performance ratio). The brand embodies a determined, hands-on, can-do attitude — encouraging people not to wait but to simply get started on their projects.
